**Install:** double-click the OTF on macOS or the TTF on Windows. Web use and the CDN link are in the [README](https://github.com/aredebr/arede-grotesk#use-on-the-web).

**In the zip:** OTF (desktop), TTF and WOFF2 (web), plus the license, README and CHANGELOG. Full history in the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/aredebr/arede-grotesk/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
